meaning.en: Open, honest and above board.
meaning.zh: 形容心地坦白，言行正派，没有私心。

examples.zh: 有意见就光明正大地提出来，别在背后议论。
examples.en: If you disagree, say so openly instead of talking behind people's backs.

examples.zh: 我们是光明正大地赢下这场比赛的。
examples.en: We won this match fair and square.

examples.zh: 他做生意一向光明正大。
examples.en: He has always done business honestly.

usage.en: Adverbial (光明正大地…), predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语、定语。

meaning.en: With one's whole mind set on a single thing.
meaning.zh: 一心一意，把心思全放在一件事上。

examples.zh: 他一门心思想考研究生。
examples.en: He's completely set on getting into graduate school.

examples.zh: 她一门心思扑在工作上，连家都顾不上。
examples.en: She throws herself so completely into work that she neglects her family.

examples.zh: 这孩子一门心思只想踢球。
examples.en: All this kid thinks about is football.

usage.en: Adverbial, often 一门心思地/想/扑在…上. Colloquial.
usage.zh: 多作状语，常说“一门心思扑在……上”。口语。

meaning.en: There are many such cases; not just one or two.
meaning.zh: 不止一种或一次，形容同类的事物或现象很多。

equivalents: and so on and so forth

examples.zh: 顾客的投诉五花八门，不一而足。
examples.en: Customer complaints come in every shape and form — too many to list.

examples.zh: 这类例子不一而足。
examples.en: There are any number of examples like this.

examples.zh: 赛场上的精彩瞬间不一而足。
examples.en: The match was full of memorable moments.

story.en: The Gongyang commentary explains that the Chunqiu's praise of the 'barbarian' states was given sparingly: 'not all at once to the full' (不一而足) — over time the phrase came to mean 'not just one, many'.
story.zh: 《公羊传·文公九年》：“许夷狄者，不一而足也。”原指不是一事一物可以满足，后指同类事物很多。

usage.en: Predicate, usually ending a list or sentence.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于列举之后。

natural: mountains of paperwork and endless meetings

meaning.en: Excessive paperwork and meetings, typical of bureaucracy.
meaning.zh: 文件多如山，会议多如海，形容官僚作风下文件和会议过多。

examples.zh: 基层干部被文山会海压得喘不过气。
examples.en: Grassroots officials are swamped with paperwork and meetings.

examples.zh: 要精简文山会海，让大家把时间用在实事上。
examples.en: We need to cut the red tape so people can spend time on real work.

usage.en: Subject or object; common in official calls for reform (精简/摆脱文山会海).
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语，常说“精简文山会海”“摆脱文山会海”。

natural: outstanding in both character and art

meaning.en: Admirable both as a person and as an artist.
meaning.zh: 品德和艺术都很高尚出众，多用来称赞文艺工作者。

equivalents: of fine character and great artistry

examples.zh: 这位老艺术家德艺双馨，深受观众爱戴。
examples.en: This veteran artist, admired for both character and craft, is beloved by audiences.

examples.zh: 我们要培养德艺双馨的文艺人才。
examples.en: We must train performers who excel both morally and artistically.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praise for performers and artists.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，用于称赞文艺工作者。

meaning.en: To consider the interests of the whole and set aside personal concerns.
meaning.zh: 照顾到整体利益，使之不受损害。

examples.zh: 他顾全大局，主动让出了主力位置。
examples.en: Putting the team first, he gave up his starting place.

examples.zh: 夫妻吵架时也要顾全大局，别伤了孩子。
examples.en: Even when couples argue, they should think of the bigger picture and not hurt the children.

examples.zh: 在关键时刻，大家都能顾全大局。
examples.en: At the crucial moment everyone put the common good first.

usage.en: Predicate; often 要/能顾全大局.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“要顾全大局”。

natural: willing to go up or down

meaning.en: Able to accept promotion or demotion with equal grace; of cadres, being movable between posts.
meaning.zh: 能担任高职，也能担任低职，指干部任用灵活，个人不计较职位高低。

equivalents: take both promotion and demotion in one's stride

examples.zh: 干部要能上能下，能进能出。
examples.en: Officials must accept being moved up or down, in or out.

examples.zh: 他能上能下，当过局长也当过科员。
examples.en: He's taken it all in his stride — he's been a bureau chief and a junior clerk.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 能进能出 in personnel-policy language.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“能进能出”连用，多见于人事制度用语。

meaning.en: To charge out in front; to take the lead.
meaning.zh: 作战时策马冲在最前面，比喻领先或带头。

examples.zh: 比赛一开始，他就一马当先冲在最前面。
examples.en: From the start he took the lead and stayed out in front.

examples.zh: 抗洪抢险中，党员干部一马当先。
examples.en: During the flood relief, officials led from the front.

examples.zh: 在新能源领域，这家公司一马当先。
examples.en: This company is leading the way in new energy.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。

natural: long preparation, then a strong showing

meaning.en: To build up a deep store of knowledge or strength before putting it to use.
meaning.zh: 长期大量积累，然后才慢慢地、少量地施展出来。

equivalents: overnight success ten years in the making

examples.zh: 他十年磨一剑，厚积薄发，终于写出了这部小说。
examples.en: After ten years of quiet preparation, he finally produced this novel.

examples.zh: 学习要厚积薄发，不能急于求成。
examples.en: Learning means building deep foundations; you can't rush it.

examples.zh: 这支球队厚积薄发，今年终于夺冠。
examples.en: Years of building paid off when the team finally won the title this season.

story.en: Su Shi advised a young friend to 'read widely and select carefully; accumulate richly and release sparingly' (博观而约取，厚积而薄发).
story.zh: 苏轼《稼说送张琥》：“博观而约取，厚积而薄发。”

usage.en: Predicate; essay favourite.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，作文常用。

natural: make a scene for no reason

meaning.en: To make trouble or a fuss without any justification.
meaning.zh: 毫无理由地跟人吵闹，故意捣乱。

equivalents: kick up a fuss over nothing

examples.zh: 孩子在超市里无理取闹，非要买玩具。
examples.en: The child threw a tantrum in the supermarket demanding a toy.

examples.zh: 你这是无理取闹！
examples.en: You're being completely unreasonable!

examples.zh: 少数顾客无理取闹，店员也很无奈。
examples.en: A few customers made scenes for no reason, leaving staff exasperated.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

natural: help pours in from all sides

meaning.en: Help coming from all quarters, typically for a disaster area.
meaning.zh: 各方面都来援助，多指支援受灾地区。

examples.zh: 地震发生后，全国八方支援灾区。
examples.en: After the earthquake, help poured into the disaster zone from all over the country.

examples.zh: 一方有难，八方支援。
examples.en: When one place is in trouble, help comes from everywhere.

usage.en: Predicate; often in 一方有难，八方支援.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“一方有难，八方支援”。

meaning.en: Deep affection and strong friendship.
meaning.zh: 深厚的感情和友谊。

examples.zh: 我们永远不会忘记两国人民的深情厚谊。
examples.en: We will never forget the deep friendship between our two peoples.

examples.zh: 这份礼物凝聚着老同学的深情厚谊。
examples.en: This gift carries all the warmth of old classmates' friendship.

usage.en: Object; formal, common in speeches and letters.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，多用于讲话、书信。

meaning.en: To survive in name only, having lost all substance.
meaning.zh: 名义上还存在，实际上已经消亡。

examples.zh: 这个协会早已名存实亡。
examples.en: The association has long existed in name only.

examples.zh: 他们的婚姻名存实亡。
examples.en: Their marriage is a marriage in name only.

examples.zh: 周朝末年，天子的权力名存实亡。
examples.en: By the late Zhou, the king's power was nominal.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: To feel relieved, as if a heavy load had been lifted.
meaning.zh: 像放下了沉重的担子，形容紧张后的轻松愉快。

examples.zh: 考完最后一门，我如释重负。
examples.en: After the last exam I felt a huge weight lift off me.

examples.zh: 听到手术成功的消息，家人如释重负。
examples.en: Hearing the operation had succeeded, the family breathed a sigh of relief.

examples.zh: 项目终于交付了，团队如释重负。
examples.en: With the project finally delivered, the team felt enormously relieved.

story.en: When Duke Zhao of Lu was driven into exile, the people were glad 'as if relieved of a heavy burden' (民如释重负).
story.zh: 《穀梁传·昭公二十九年》：“昭公出奔，民如释重负。”

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。

meaning.en: Unshakeably fixed; done without fail whatever happens.
meaning.zh: 形容意志坚定或规定严格，无论如何都不改变。

examples.zh: 他每天早上跑步五公里，雷打不动。
examples.en: He runs five kilometres every morning, rain or shine.

examples.zh: 每周日陪父母吃饭，这是我们家雷打不动的规矩。
examples.en: Sunday lunch with my parents is a fixed rule in our family.

examples.zh: 训练计划雷打不动。
examples.en: The training schedule is set in stone.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; colloquial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。口语。

natural: stretching as far as the eye can see

meaning.en: So vast that one cannot see its edge.
meaning.zh: 一眼望不到边，形容非常辽阔。

equivalents: as far as the eye can see

examples.zh: 车窗外是一望无际的麦田。
examples.en: Outside the window, wheat fields stretched as far as the eye could see.

examples.zh: 站在海边，眼前是一望无际的大海。
examples.en: Standing on the shore, I faced a boundless sea.

examples.zh: 内蒙古草原一望无际。
examples.en: The grasslands of Inner Mongolia seem to go on forever.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; describes plains, seas, fields.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，形容草原、大海、田野等。

meaning.en: Completely isolated from the outside world.
meaning.zh: 跟外界隔离，断绝往来。

equivalents: cut off from the outside world

examples.zh: 这个小山村几乎与世隔绝。
examples.en: This little mountain village is almost completely cut off from the world.

examples.zh: 他把自己关在家里，过着与世隔绝的生活。
examples.en: He shut himself away at home, living in total isolation.

examples.zh: 考前一个月，她决定与世隔绝，专心复习。
examples.en: A month before the exam she went off the grid to revise.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: Half believing and half doubting.
meaning.zh: 有些相信，又有些怀疑。

equivalents: take with a pinch of salt

examples.zh: 听了他的解释，大家将信将疑。
examples.en: After his explanation, people were only half convinced.

examples.zh: 她将信将疑地打开了那封邮件。
examples.en: She opened the email with some suspicion.

story.en: Li Hua's lament for soldiers fallen on ancient battlefields: families never learned whether their men lived or died, and when someone brought word, 'they half believed, half doubted' (将信将疑).
story.zh: 李华《吊古战场文》：“其存其殁，家莫闻知；人或有言，将信将疑。”

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; slightly more literary than 半信半疑.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，比“半信半疑”稍书面。

meaning.en: Basic household necessities; the practical concerns of everyday life.
meaning.zh: 泛指日常生活必需品，也指平凡琐碎的日常生活。

examples.zh: 结婚以后，浪漫慢慢变成了柴米油盐。
examples.en: After the wedding, romance gradually gave way to the daily grind.

examples.zh: 不当家不知柴米油盐贵。
examples.en: You don't know what the basics cost until you run a household.

examples.zh: 她每天操心的都是柴米油盐的事。
examples.en: Her days are taken up with household chores and bills.

usage.en: Subject, object or attributive; full form 柴米油盐酱醋茶.
usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语、定语；全称“柴米油盐酱醋茶”。

meaning.en: Half believing, half doubting.
meaning.zh: 有点相信，又有点怀疑。

examples.zh: 对这个广告，我半信半疑。
examples.en: I'm sceptical about this advert.

examples.zh: 孩子半信半疑地看着魔术师。
examples.en: The child watched the magician, not quite believing it.

examples.zh: 听说要放假，同学们半信半疑。
examples.en: Hearing about the holiday, the students weren't sure whether to believe it.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。

meaning.en: To have no means left to deal with a situation.
meaning.zh: 没有办法可用。

examples.zh: 医生们也无计可施了。
examples.en: Even the doctors were out of options.

examples.zh: 面对孩子的哭闹，年轻的父亲无计可施。
examples.en: Faced with the screaming child, the young father was at his wits' end.

examples.zh: 对方防守太严，我们一时无计可施。
examples.en: Their defence was so tight we couldn't find a way through.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: To go into action without burdens — physical, mental or financial.
meaning.zh: 不带沉重装备上阵，比喻放下思想包袱或负担，投入工作或比赛。

equivalents: go in with nothing to lose

examples.zh: 没有了夺冠压力，球队轻装上阵。
examples.en: With no pressure to win the title, the team played freely.

examples.zh: 企业甩掉债务包袱，轻装上阵。
examples.en: Freed of its debts, the company could start afresh.

examples.zh: 放下顾虑，轻装上阵，你一定能考好。
examples.en: Put your worries aside and go in relaxed — you'll do well.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: In a terrible mess; utterly hopeless. Also used after 得 for 'extremely'.
meaning.zh: 形容乱到不可收拾或糟到极点；也用在“得”后表示程度极深。

examples.zh: 房间乱得一塌糊涂。
examples.en: The room is a complete mess.

examples.zh: 这次考试我考得一塌糊涂。
examples.en: I made a total hash of this exam.

examples.zh: 那部电影把她感动得一塌糊涂。
examples.en: That film moved her to pieces.

usage.en: Complement after 得, or predicate; casual.
usage.zh: 多作补语（“……得一塌糊涂”）、谓语。口语。

meaning.en: Powerfully moving or stirring.
meaning.zh: 使人内心受到强烈震动。

examples.zh: 这部纪录片的结尾震撼人心。
examples.en: The ending of this documentary is deeply moving.

examples.zh: 他的演讲震撼人心。
examples.en: His speech was electrifying.

examples.zh: 那是一幅震撼人心的画面。
examples.en: It was a powerful image.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: Needs that may arise unexpectedly at any time.
meaning.zh: 随时可能出现的需要。

examples.zh: 存点钱以备不时之需。
examples.en: Put some money aside for a rainy day.

examples.zh: 包里放把伞，以备不时之需。
examples.en: Keep an umbrella in your bag, just in case.

examples.zh: 这些药放在家里，以应不时之需。
examples.en: Keep these medicines at home for emergencies.

usage.en: Object, almost always 以备不时之需.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“以备不时之需”。
